per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Initial packet inventory was structurally sufficient but its supplementary-table parser did not structure the SI PDF tables; owner-layer rework consumed the local SI PDF without rerunning bootstrap.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Required final artifacts exist and are parseable; validator contract is separate from semantic/publication acceptance.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay and experiment rows are reconciled against primary source tables when exact; ambiguous metal-state rows remain source_conflict with concrete context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: MIC and RPTEC viability rows are now represented from SI Tables S4, S6, and S7 with raw values, units, target species/strain, methods, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism evidence is bounded to coordination/antimicrobial context and liposome leakage; no unsupported direct intracellular target is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking or major open rework ticket remains after source-reviewed repair; acceptance is with cautions because database metal-state ambiguity is preserved.

activity_target_species_and_units.evidence: All activity/toxicity records have endpoint, raw value, unit, target species/strain, assay context, and source locator.

database_conflict_preservation.evidence: Ambiguous metal-state DBAASP rows remain source_conflict with concrete conflict_context and source locators.

mechanism_overclaim_check.evidence: Only the liposome leakage claim is direct_mechanism and it carries a direct assay type; coordination claims are indirect context.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Local SI PDF Tables S4, S6, and S7 were source-reviewed with pdftotext layout and represented as row-level activity/toxicity records.
Some DBAASP MIC rows provide sequence/subject/value but omit Cu(II)/Zn(II) complex annotation; these remain source_conflict with table locators rather than being silently source_verified.
Figure 1 caption notes tyrosine residues in clavanins C/D could be modified; final database audit does not normalize that caveat away.
